products.name: Ridgeline Camo Jacket
products.summary: A windproof camouflage jacket with a durable nylon shell, built for hunting trips and outdoor adventures.
description: Stay protected from the wind with the Ridgeline Camo Jacket. Designed for outdoor use, it features a durable 100% nylon shell, polyester backing, and a PU laminate layer in a practical camouflage pattern.

Ideal for hunting trips, woodland walks, and everyday outdoor wear, this jacket works well as an outer layer over suitable base and insulating layers. For best results, wash on a cold, gentle cycle and line dry. Avoid bleach and fabric softener.
features: Suitable for layering in changing conditions
Machine wash cold on a gentle cycle
Line dry; do not use bleach or fabric softener
